name: alvearium
description: Alvearium (formerly session-board): one ticket board for all your Claude Code sessions and agents, terminal and claude.ai/code cloud: what waits on you, what is in progress, what to do next. Live updates, dependencies, priorities, who-talks-to-whom history and a feedback inbox.

server_url.title: Board server URL (optional)
server_url.description: Base URL of your Alvearium server, e.g. https://board.example.com. Leave empty for local mode (this machine only).

token.title: Board server token (optional)
token.description: Bearer token of your Alvearium server. Leave empty for local mode.
